PACIENTES_INATIVOS.descricaoVazio: No patients inactive for over {{dias}} days indicates good retention and lowers the risk of losing recurring revenue.
PACIENTES_INATIVOS.descricao: Some patients have had no appointment for over {{dias}} days and none scheduled. Without contact, their recurring revenue may be lost.
PACIENTES_INATIVOS.acaoVazio: Keep sending reminders and personalized messages to maintain patient engagement. Use the online schedule to make rebooking easy.
PACIENTES_INATIVOS.acao: Contact these patients on WhatsApp, offer a follow-up and use the online schedule to make rebooking easy.

PACIENTES_PENDENTES_RETORNO.descricaoVazio: No patients pending follow-up shows that care flow is organized and loyalty is high.
PACIENTES_PENDENTES_RETORNO.descricao: Some patients have an appointment marked "Reschedule" with no new date. Without follow-up, the clinic risks losing them.
PACIENTES_PENDENTES_RETORNO.acaoVazio: Track follow-up dates with automatic WhatsApp notifications and encourage early booking.
PACIENTES_PENDENTES_RETORNO.acao: Contact them to reschedule these appointments and confirm the new date on the schedule.

FAIXAS_BAIXA_OCUPACAO.tituloVazio: No time slots with low occupancy
FAIXAS_BAIXA_OCUPACAO.descricaoVazio: Schedule occupancy is balanced across time slots over the last weeks.
FAIXAS_BAIXA_OCUPACAO.descricao: Some time slots are below 50% of the average occupancy over the last 12 weeks. This means idle capacity and potential lost revenue.
FAIXAS_BAIXA_OCUPACAO.acaoVazio: Keep the current schedule distribution and track occupancy weekly.
FAIXAS_BAIXA_OCUPACAO.acao: Create specific promotions for low-occupancy slots, such as discounts or perks, and move professionals to those times.

FALTAS_RECENTES.tituloVazio: No no-shows in the last {{dias}} days
FALTAS_RECENTES.descricaoVazio: With no no-shows in the period, the schedule is fully used and revenue is predictable.
FALTAS_RECENTES.descricao: No-shows in the last {{dias}} days can hurt revenue and schedule planning. Recurring no-shows can cause financial losses.
FALTAS_RECENTES.acaoVazio: Keep automatic confirmations on to stay free of no-shows.
FALTAS_RECENTES.acao: Send personalized reminders and confirm appointments on WhatsApp ahead of time. Consider a confirmation policy to reduce no-shows.

PROFISSIONAIS_SUBUTILIZADOS.tituloVazio: No professionals with an underused schedule
PROFISSIONAIS_SUBUTILIZADOS.descricaoVazio: All professionals are close to the average number of appointments over the last {{dias}} days.
PROFISSIONAIS_SUBUTILIZADOS.descricao: Professionals with an underused schedule saw less than 50% of the average of {{media}} appointments in {{dias}} days. There is room to grow revenue.
PROFISSIONAIS_SUBUTILIZADOS.acao: Review the schedule of underused professionals to redistribute patients or promote open slots on WhatsApp.

ANIVERSARIANTES_PROXIMOS.tituloVazio: No birthdays in the next {{dias}} days
ANIVERSARIANTES_PROXIMOS.descricaoVazio: No patients have a birthday in the coming days.
ANIVERSARIANTES_PROXIMOS.descricao: Birthdays are a good chance to build loyalty with personalized messages and special offers.
ANIVERSARIANTES_PROXIMOS.acaoVazio: Keep an eye on upcoming birthdays to nurture patient relationships.
ANIVERSARIANTES_PROXIMOS.acao: Send birthday messages on WhatsApp with exclusive offers and suggest complementary services.

INATIVOS_POR_PROFISSIONAL.descricaoVazio: No inactive patients per professional shows good loyalty, with steady returns to regular professionals.
INATIVOS_POR_PROFISSIONAL.descricao: Some patients have not returned to the same professional in over {{dias}} days and have nothing scheduled with them.
INATIVOS_POR_PROFISSIONAL.acaoVazio: Keep encouraging the direct relationship between patients and their usual professionals.
INATIVOS_POR_PROFISSIONAL.acao: Ask the professionals to reach out to their patients and offer a follow-up.
